entries.214e6378d98ec153: Leasing of rental apartments and office buildings
entries.6559a5d3359b7fda: This business leases real estate, including company-owned rental apartments and office buildings. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥117 million. It has rental properties in Nishinomiya City, Hyōgo Prefecture and elsewhere.
entries.84b2976d1e126ce3: This is the core business, manufacturing and selling concrete secondary products such as road-related products, Baikon pipes and Baikon manholes. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,297 million. The Kasai Plant in Kasai City, Hyōgo Prefecture has manufacturing facilities for road products and others, and the Osaka Branch and others handle sales, management and research and development.
entries.a3168cc17b19ee21: A company centered on the manufacture and sale of secondary concrete products, which also sells and installs building equipment and leases real estate.
entries.c57120a753aa158c: This business sells, installs and maintains building equipment, mainly air-conditioning equipment. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,518 million. The Building Equipment Department in Chuo Ward, Kobe City and others has sales facilities.
